summary: This Form 6-K filed by GSK plc on June 24, 2026 reports a routine transaction notification under UK market abuse rules. It discloses that Maya Martinez-Davis, President US, acquired 9.4103 notional American Depositary Shares at $50.74 per share within her Executive Supplemental Savings Plan account on June 22, 2026. There is no corporate action, merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. The filing is a standard PDMR shareholding disclosure, not a special situation event.
